def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_row = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row+1:]
        if not a or not b:
            return []
        # Compare aligned cells; choose orientation with the most matches.
        direct = sum(x == y for ra, rb in zip(a, b) for x, y in zip(ra, rb))
        rev = sum(x == y for ra, rb in zip(a, b) for x, y in zip(ra, rb[::-1]))
        if rev > direct:
            b = [row[::-1] for row in b]
        common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
        bg = next(iter(common)) if common else 0
        return [[3 if x == y else bg for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    sep_col = next(j for j in range(w) if all(row[j] == grid[0][j] for row in grid))
    a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
    b = [row[sep_col+1:] for row in grid]
    direct = sum(x == y for ra, rb in zip(a, b) for x, y in zip(ra, rb))
    rev = sum(x == y for ra, rb in zip(a, b) for x, y in zip(ra, rb[::-1]))
    if rev > direct:
        b = [row[::-1] for row in b]
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    bg = next(iter(common)) if common else 0
    return [[3 if x == y else bg for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
